run_boost_build_test_project: run the Boost.Build project test that verifies multi-directory build output and target dependencies
test_boost_build_target_ids: test that target ids on the command line correctly build specific objects in subdirectories
test_boost_build_project_ids: test that project ids on the command line build all targets in a given project directory
test_boost_build_incremental_rebuild: test that touching a source file triggers incremental rebuild of dependent targets only
test_boost_build_clean_operations: test that clean and clean-all operations remove the correct build artifacts
